pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Axe$() and $(l)Red Matter Axe$() chop wood and work on copper. Craft the Dark Matter Axe from Dark Matter and a diamond, then upgrade it into the Red Matter Axe.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge; the axe has no mode key.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Right-click a log to strip it in an area; the radius grows with charge.$(li)Right-click oxidized copper to scrape it and waxed blocks to remove the wax, again in an area.$(li)Right-click any log while charged to fell the whole tree: five blocks horizontally per charge and twice that vertically, for free.$(li)All of these actions are free.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() server.items.disableAllRadiusMining.
